detail: generic-runner's run_command executes a real shell with machine-wide filesystem access. Trace audits found attempts reading reference/grader files outside the workspace (absolute paths to experiments/tool-side-harness/tasks|targets, expected.json, reference.sh), contaminating held-out hiding and some held-in minimal cells.
clean_cells: dsh-pilot-editing-v3b: 0 escape traces across all 18 attempts
remediation: generic-runner.js now refuses run_command with home-directory expansion, parent-directory traversal, or absolute paths outside the workspace (research-integrity boundary, not a security sandbox). Contaminated cells are re-run under the hardened runner with new run ids.
claim_impact: Frozen records that cite contaminated numbers are flagged; the v3 final record uses hardened-runner numbers for every cited cell.
